goal.statement: People gain durable practical agency as technological capability expands.

outcome_scope.people: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
outcome_scope.standard: no involuntary loss of real hourly earnings or essential employment conditions attributable to the transition

metric.measure: workers with a rehearsed accessible and rejectable option
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: worker level before any cohort summary
metric.evaluation_rule: Count a worker only after accessibility, refusal and appeal checks all pass.

signals.label: Failed or rejected transition option rate

metric.measure: transition options rejected or failing a delivery check
metric.denominator: all scoped workers offered an option
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: worker level before any cohort summary
metric.evaluation_rule: Retain refusals and failed checks in the denominator and publish reasons separately.

metric.measure: workers reporting anxiety, stigma, coercion or false certainty caused by an offer
metric.denominator: all scoped workers receiving transition information
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: worker level with severe cases retained separately
metric.evaluation_rule: Report every severe case separately before any cohort rate.

metric.measure: independently reviewed comparable offers available per worker
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.evaluation_rule: Count an offer only when pay, hours, conditions, location and worker eligibility are independently checked.

metric.measure: offers withdrawn or failing the registered quality standard
metric.denominator: all offers presented to scoped workers
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: offer level linked to worker scope
metric.evaluation_rule: Retain withdrawn and failed offers rather than deleting them from the denominator.

signals.label: Stigma or pressure caused by offer labelling

metric.measure: workers reporting stigma, pressure or loss of choice caused by offer labelling
metric.denominator: all scoped workers shown labelled offers
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: worker level with severe cases retained separately
metric.evaluation_rule: Report severe loss-of-choice cases separately before any summary.

metric.measure: funded service and appeal capacity relative to registered demand
metric.denominator: registered peak service and appeal demand
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: service component with the minimum ratio controlling
metric.evaluation_rule: Require funding, staff, appeals and recovery capacity to pass separately.

signals.label: Service failure and unmet appeal load

metric.measure: service failures and appeals unresolved inside the service level
metric.denominator: all scoped workers served or appealing
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: case level with unresolved cases retained
metric.evaluation_rule: Count every missed service level and unresolved appeal without offsetting across people.

metric.measure: workers reporting anxiety, stigma or false reassurance from protection messaging
metric.denominator: all scoped workers receiving protection messaging
metric.population: Australian employees in ANZSCO 5311 General Clerks roles at participating workplaces
metric.aggregation: worker level with severe cases retained separately
metric.evaluation_rule: Report severe cases and false reassurance before any cohort rate.

action_hypotheses.mechanism: Rehearsal may expose delivery gaps before a worker faces a role change.
action_hypotheses.falsifier: Readiness does not improve, or rejection, burden or information harm increases under the preregistered comparison.

action_hypotheses.mechanism: A trial may identify viable redesigned work before changing scoped roles.
action_hypotheses.falsifier: Comparable offer flow does not increase, or withdrawal, quality failure, pressure or stigma rises.

action_hypotheses.mechanism: Reserved resources may make a future lawful compact more deliverable without activating it.
action_hypotheses.falsifier: Capacity does not improve, funding crowds out a better option, or service failure and information harm rise.
